Technical.ExcludedExecution: drive-main-interrupted-sequential: interrupted before trial completion solely to parallelize fixed variants; no behavior-based selection

Statistics: Evaluation worlds averaged within each training seed; mean and sample SD across five training seeds. Paired differences are Right minus Left.
Limitations: Five training seeds; one controlled physical configuration.
Boar metrics measure proximity, not harm or survival.
Temporal SD must be read alongside mean/threshold time; constant high hunger can have low SD.
Longest runs are censored by the 4000-step evaluation horizon.
Reward diagnostics are not comparable behavioral success scores; BehaviorOutcome is not-assessed.
No overall ranking or winner; older experiments are not pooled.
